Silver Coin. Denarius of Vespasian (69-79), Reece period 4, mint of Rome issue of 77-78, RIC volume 2 no. 103. Obverse description: Craggy bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: IMP CAES VESPA[--]. Reverse description: Mars standing left holding spear and trophy. Reverse inscription: COS[---].
